name: Choices We Make
overview: Scripture clearly presents the choices we make as pivotal to our relationship with God and the blessings He bestows. We are called to choose life by obeying God's commandments and serving Him wholeheartedly, as seen in Deuteronomy's call to life and Joshua's challenge to serve the Lord or other gods. Trusting in the Lord rather than our own understanding guides wise decisions, while our actions have lasting consequences not only for ourselves but for future generations, as Proverbs highlights the inheritance of the righteous and the discord sown by the wicked.
